basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old living in Huntington Beach, working as a freelance graphic designer. I love snickerdoodles and often share my baking tips with fellow enthusiasts on Reddit. I'm quite passionate about exploring new shortcuts in design software, which is probably why I frequent the 'shortcuts' subreddit. When I'm not working, you might find me enjoying the outdoors or dealing with my BPPV, which has been an ongoing challenge. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, and I'm currently single, focusing on my career and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been freelancing for the past five years. My interest in technology and design software has led me to be self-taught in several advanced features, which I enjoy discussing and sharing on Reddit.
